prefill_chunk_buckets.planner: OptimizedDecoder._chunk_plan: token steps until start is page/32 aligned, full 4096 chunks, then a cost-model choice (per-layer constants _PLAN_COST) between exact ladder buckets, one masked bucket for the remainder, and decode-path steps for remainders up to 8 tokens (for example full 4100 tokens: 4096 + 4 decode-path steps)
prefill_chunk_buckets.masked_chunk: GDN: beta and decay zeroed on padded rows and convolution history gathered from the last valid rows, so padding never enters recurrent or convolution state. Full attention: masked chunk when the page size divides the chunk, the chunk ends at or before max_seq_len (262144), and the page table (extended by the scratch page when bound) covers the padded rows; padded K/V land in owned pages beyond the logical length or in the scratch page.
prefill_chunk_buckets.moe_grouping: one MoE call per group of up to 4096 planned rows; groups pad to the next bucket for the dispatch maps
prefill_chunk_buckets.paths: aligned unpadded inputs whose plan is one exact chunk per group use the tiled slicing path; all other inputs use index-gather chunk extraction (no offset-specific programs for a fixed physical bucket)

optimized_decoder_validation.prefill_reproducibility: Prefill is not bitwise reproducible. With post_combine_reduce (MoE groups below 2048 rows) a repeat differs in 1-3 32-row blocks; with the k-major tile combine (groups of 2048+ rows) a repeat can differ in most blocks (up to 61 of 64, final_evidence15/control_grid_linear_2048/default.json). Maximum absolute difference up to 0.0029 in the final chain (final_evidence15/prefill_full_2176_s128) and 0.0078 anywhere (optimized_decoder/review2/bfp8_grid/full_1024/small4x4_large11x8.json); repeat PCC at least 0.99999994 in every non-identical final-chain run. Root cause unresolved (state left by preceding ops; review2/drift covers post_combine_reduce). Traced decode replay is bitwise reproducible.

serving_contract.kv_scratch_page: Reserve one K/V page per pool outside the serving block allocator and pass it as bind_paged_kv_cache(..., scratch_block=index). Padded rows of a masked full-attention chunk that fall beyond the request page table write there. Without it, the planner only plans masked chunks that fit inside the page table.
serving_contract.page_table_ownership: Every page-table entry up to the table width must be owned by the request or point at the scratch page. The planner treats all entries as owned: padded K/V rows beyond the logical length are written to the request's own pages (overwritten before they are read).
serving_contract.extended_table_width: Chunk prefill uses the page table plus 4096/page_size scratch entries; decode-path steps use the original table (paged_fused_update_cache requires width <= pool pages).
serving_contract.combine_modes: post_combine_reduce for MoE groups below 2048 rows; k-major tile combine (fast_reduce_nc) from 2048 rows; 8x8 moe_fused_swiglu grid from 2048 rows, 4x4 below.
serving_contract.warm_up_note: A generator must run every listed chunk shape and MoE dispatch bucket for each physical input bucket before the first decode trace capture; prefill while a trace is alive then compiles no new programs (validated by run_reuse/run_positions with program-cache misses forbidden).

multichip_decoder_validation.capacity_method: Per-layer weights from the root-buffer inventory (DRAM payload by unique buffer). Constants that are identical in every layer (RoPE tables, dispatch maps, zero templates, index tables) are counted once. GDN state counted per configured slot. Embedding BF16 replicated; LM head BFP8 sharded by vocabulary. Reserve of 2 GiB for activations, trace and CCL buffers is an estimate until the full model measures it.
